subject: QBR Orchestrator: exec flags and renewal registry for NimbusCloud
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR Orchestrator: exec flags and renewal registry for NimbusCloud

Team —

We have a QBR scheduled with NimbusCloud the week of May 22. I want to put together a compact packet for execs that calls out: customer health, renewal risk registry, and the handful of items that require senior attention. High-level ask below — aim to have a draft for internal review by EOD May 16.

1) Health snapshot: one slide/table with usage trends (tokens/day), latency P50/P95, feature adoption (vector search, embeddings), and top support tickets open >7d. Grace — can you pull the last 90 days and flag any regressions?
2) Renewal risk register: list of discrete risks (procurement delays, latency incidents, seat churn, contract questions), owners, mitigation steps, and severity (high/med/low). Jordan — please coordinate with Sales Ops to confirm contract dates and any outstanding redlines.
3) Exec attention items: anything that needs a CTO/Head of Prod escalation (SLA exceptions, compliance asks, credits). Karthik — anything on the infra/ops side that should go to the execs?

Attachments: nimbus_health_snapshot.xlsx (template), draft_exec_one-pager.docx (starter).

Let's keep language tight — this will be forwarded to the account exec and the CEO/VPs. If we can converge on a one-pager and risk registry by Tue (May 16) morning, I will synthesize into a final PDF for the QBR deck.

Thanks —
Logan
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR Orchestrator: exec flags and renewal registry for NimbusCloud

Logan —

Thanks, pushing the 90-day slice now. Quick notes from preliminary analysis:

- Usage: tokens/day up ~12% MoM driven by two internal pilot teams; embeddings calls steady.
- Latency: we saw two P95 spikes on 2028-04-18 and 2028-04-27 tied to a model rollout; impact measured ~300 requests (investigating). Draft timeline attached (latency_incident_timeline.pdf).
- Support: 3 open tickets >7d. One is a feature-request (vector search on historical index), one is a billing clarification, one is an intermittent auth error (investigating).
- Adoption risk: pilot teams are cost-sensitive; if cost-per-request doesn't trend down they may throttle.

I'll populate the health snapshot and tag risks with severity and initial mitigations. ETA: May 15 COB for the first draft.

Grace
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Joe Sanders <joe.sanders@nimbuscloud.com>, procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Date: 2028-05-14T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QBR Orchestrator: exec flags and renewal registry for NimbusCloud

FYI — looping in Joe from Nimbus procurement to confirm timing on the renewal and resolve a couple of contract items before the QBR.

Joe — forwarding our internal working thread. High level: NB contract renewal window opens June 1. Two risks flagged: 1) procurement asked for a dedicated data retention SLA (they're evaluating Private deployment options) and 2) an outstanding billing credit request from an April incident (being validated). Can you confirm procurement's timeline for decisioning and whether they need an exec call?

Also pinging internal ops (Karthik) for any infra notes we should highlight for the procurement team.

--
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — I reviewed Grace's draft and Jordan's procurement note and pulled together an executive one-pager (attached: qbr_exec_summary_v1.pdf). Key callouts in plain language for the execs:

- Health: steady usage growth, two latency spikes tied to model rollout; mitigations in flight (rollback + kernel tuning).
- Renewal risk: procurement timeline tight (decision window by June 1). Primary risks = SLA ask for Private deployment (data residency) and billing credit resolution. Severity: High (procurement/SLA), Medium (billing).
- Ask for execs: approve a short 30-min call between Redwood Head of Product and NimbusCloud CTO to discuss Private deployment feasibility, and pre-approve a one-time billing credit cap of $22k to expedite close if the root cause validation completes.

Joe — can your team confirm availability for a quick exec alignment call next week?

If no major edits, I will finalize and push to DocuSign & HubSpot by EOD Friday and include the risk registry as an appendix.

Attachments: qbr_exec_summary_v1.pdf
